jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Build the field software that helps maintain and update information about the network for Electric, Gas, Water or Telecommunications.
  
When work happens in the Field, whether its event driven, maintenance activities, or other planned work, We build the software those crews and Field Engineers use. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead continued improvements to the products at the center of that work: GridOS Field and its unified App and User Experience. One field app supporting many complex business flows and outcomes
  
This role owns how utility field workers capture critical information while performing work. Your decisions will shape how quickly and efficiently utilities capture and maintain data that is constantly changing in the Field.

**Job Description**
===================

Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for product and workflow inside GridOS Field. Your day to day will include:

* **Owning the roadmap.** Set direction for new workflows and enhancements to GridOS Field. Prioritize based on customer needs, technology changes, regulatory drivers, and business impact.
* **Working with customers.** Spend time with utility damage assessors, field supervisors, and control room staff. Validate real problems before writing a single requirement.
* **Working with your Peer Product Management teams who also manage the product lifecycle of GridOS Field**
* **Driving delivery.** Partner with engineering, design, and UX to ship high quality releases on a predictable cadence. Support the Lean operating rhythm.
* **Working with Requirements Management tools: These** tools help document and drive the roadmaps and priorities that help shape strategy, delivery and on-going improvements to GridOS Field
* **Connecting to the platform.** Make sure your products feel like one app with the rest of GridOS Field. Work with the UX PM and the other GridOS Field PMs to keep the experience unified.
* **Using AI.** Apply AI to speed up damage triage, image capture workflows, and data quality checks. Use AI tools in your own workflow to move faster.
* **Supporting sales and delivery.** Join customer calls, write positioning material, and help account teams win and deliver deals with Southern Company, PPL, and the accounts that follow them.
* **Guiding customers off legacy.** Help utilities move from FieldSmart, AEMS, and other legacy tools onto the modern GridOS Field platform.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Product management or other Management experience with complex enterprise software, ideally in utilities, energy, telecom, or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of utility field operations, outage restoration, or ADMS/DMS/OMS and other Field Maintenance Flows. If you have not lived it, you have shipped software to people who have.
* A track record of running more than one program at a time with a clear, data-driven approach.
* Comfort with AI tools in your own product workflow.
* Strong writing and communication. You can turn a messy customer conversation into a clear requirement, a crisp roadmap update, or a one-page memo.
* Commercial judgment. You can connect a product decision to a revenue, cost, or customer outcome.
* A Lean and Agile mindset. You adjust quickly when priorities shift, and you close things out.

**Education Requirements**
--------------------------

**For US candidates:** A Master's degree, or a High School Diploma/GED with at least six years of professional experience.

**For non-US candidates:** A Master's equivalent, or a High School Diploma with relevant professional experience.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

You will work on software that utilities depend on during their most challenging times to maintain infrastructure stability while experiencing exponential growth in demand. restoring service.

We offer:

* **Real impact.** Providing Value to Large Tier 1 and Tier2 Utility and Telco companies, with a clear runway to grow.
* **Modern stack.** Single-tenant SaaS on hyperscaler infrastructure, with AI built in through the Prism platform.
* **Direct customer contact.** You talk to the people using the product, not just the people buying it.
* **Growth.** GridOS Field is scaling. Strong PMs move up.

**Success in This Role**
------------------------

You will know you are succeeding when the Adoption rate of GridOS Field increasing and becomes a key part of both our existing customer base and prospects.

**Working Arrangement**
-----------------------

Permanent, fully remote. Occasional travel to customer sites and GE Vernova offices.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from everyone who meets the criteria and is interested in the future of the grid.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Associate Satisfaction
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Every day, Amazon Customer Service associates help millions of customers around the world. Their ability to deliver exceptional customer experiences depends on feeling supported, empowered, and equipped to succeed.  
  
We are building new ways to understand and improve the associate experience. By listening to associates and combining their feedback with insights from their day-to-day work, we aim to identify what drives satisfaction, recognize emerging challenges, and help leaders take meaningful action.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the development of products that help Amazon understand how associates experience their work. You will shape our associate listening strategy, define how we measure satisfaction across key moments in the associate journey, and partner with science and engineering teams to translate feedback into actionable insights.  
This is an opportunity to build new capabilities from the ground up and influence how Amazon improves the experience of its global Customer Service workforce.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and execute the product roadmap for associate listening, satisfaction measurement, and insights capabilities.
* Develop the associate listening strategy, including survey design, question development, feedback collection, and measurement experiences.
* Partner with research and science teams to establish reliable measures of associate satisfaction, engagement, and wellbeing.
* Identify key moments in the associate journey and define how feedback and experience are measured across them.
* Combine associate feedback with operational and contextual data to identify drivers of satisfaction and emerging challenges.
* Partner with engineering and science teams to build scalable products that translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Define product success metrics and evaluate the impact of new capabilities on associate experience and business outcomes.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
* Experience with survey research, employee listening platforms, Voice of Customer, or experience measurement products.
* Familiarity with survey design, sampling, response bias, and measurement validity.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Technical Content Marketer
jobs.description:
**Technical Content Marketer**

*Location: (On-site) Hyderabad, India*

**What you'll own:**

* **Distribution:** Every piece starts with a plan for who will see it and where. You'll map the channels before you write, adapt the piece for each one and track how it performs.
* **Long-form TOFU pieces:** Write blog posts, newsletters, explainers and research write-ups that make our work appeal to people evaluating AI model training and deployment.
* **BOFU content:** Create landing pages, one-pagers and pitch for our datasets across modalities (audio, languages, coding RL, physical AI and more), our RL environments and our agent observability suite. Write landing pages, one-pagers and product descriptions across STARK, Helix, VoxClash and our physical AI line.
* **SEO and AEO:** Plan content around what our buyers search for. Structure pages so search engines and AI answer engines can find and cite them.
* **Social media:** Plan and write content for Deccan's LinkedIn, X, and more.
* **Strategic case studies:** Work with customers and our sales team to write case studies that capture why each customer chose Deccan and what it changed for them.
* **Launches and announcements:** Write for funding news, partnerships, product releases and conferences.

**You'll do well here if you**

* **Shun AI slop:** You take your writing personally, and you can't stand content that reads like it came off an assembly line and recognize a technical subject is never an excuse for flat, generic content.
* **Pick up deep technical topics quickly:** You need curiosity and the patience to ask experts good questions until you understand the subject well enough to explain it.
* **Bring a point of view:** You enjoy forming opinions about the industry and backing them up in writing.
* **Obsess over quality:** You edit your own drafts closely and use feedback to improve the work.
* **Measure your work by results.** You want to know whether a piece brought in traffic, leads or conversations, and you use that to decide what to write next.
* **Use AI tools well.** You use LLMs for research and first drafts, and you know how to edit the output so it reads like a person wrote it.
* **Enjoy collaboration:** You're comfortable working with researchers, product managers, sales and design to get what a piece needs.

**Experience**

* 1–3 years in B2B content marketing, editorial, journalism or product storytelling, ideally at a dev tools SaaS/technology company.
* A portfolio of your published writing for different channels
* Hands-on experience with SEO, and familiarity with how AI answers engines surface content.

If your experience falls slightly outside this range but your work makes the case, apply anyway.

**Bonus points**

* You've written about AI, data or developer tools.
* You've written for formats beyond text, like video scripting or visual content.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Process Improvement Specialist, EU FBA
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about making operations run smoother and more efficiently? Amazon is looking for a Process Improvement Specialist to join our EU FBA Support Operations team, where you will identify opportunities to enhance workflows, reduce waste, and drive meaningful results. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional partners to build and implement solutions that directly impact team performance and the associate experience.  
  
You will bring a data-informed mindset and a knack for problem-solving to tackle real operational challenges. Whether you are analyzing process metrics, creating new standard operating procedures, or coordinating with stakeholders to roll out improvements, your contributions will help us deliver for customers more effectively every day. If you are a curious, detail-oriented self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.  
  
A successful candidate must be able to work independently, thrive in ambiguous environments, effectively influence internal/external partners at all levels of the organization. This role will particularly suit someone with a strong innovative mindset, relationship building skills, operational excellence, superior project management capabilities, and strong people management experience.  
  
Some of the qualities that we are looking for: you are results-oriented (and have a track record of repeatedly delivering great results); you are an innovator (and have already proven it); you have the intellect and horsepower to solve really complex problems (some may say impossible to solve); you are an owner, and do what it takes to make your team successful; you have relentlessly high standards (some may say too high); you are customer obsessed; you operate well in an ambiguous environment; and finally, you have a burning desire to be a part of something really big.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Analyze operational data and process metrics to identify inefficiencies, points of failure, and improvement opportunities within fulfillment center workflows.
* Build and implement process improvement initiatives that enhance team outputs, including developing standard operating procedures and automating repetitive tasks where possible.
* Collaborate with peers, managers, and partner teams to troubleshoot operational issues, escalate risks, and align on solutions that balance time and resources.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to communicate project status, track progress, and drive alignment on improvement plans, ensuring clear and concise updates across all levels.
* Monitor system performance and service levels through defined metrics, using findings to refine processes and sustain long-term operational gains.
* Support development and implementation of Automation through data-driven analysis by coordinating with wider organization and tracking progress
* Identify and implement sustainable improvements for operational excellence using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
* Execute strategic projects that deliver improvements in Seller Experience, productivity, and lowest cost-to-serve for Selling Partners and Amazon
* Collaborate with program stakeholders to clarify requirements and objectives. Support writing business and technical requirements documents
* Support establishment of business goals, metrics and key performance indicators (KPI) for success
* Build relationships with key stakeholders across global product, program and operational teams to support scalable solutions

  
A day in the life  
A typical day for an EU FBA Process Improvement Specialist will focus on executing Seller Experience initiatives and reduce Cost to Serve for Sellers and for Amazon, analyzing data to drive efficiency improvements, and collaborating with global teams to enhance seller services. Additionally, you might start your morning reviewing performance dashboards to spot trends or anomalies in s key metrics. From there, you could spend time on observing a workflow firsthand, gathering input to engage directly with stakeholders, sellers and and manage what is working and what could be better. You might draft a new procedure based on your findings, coordinate with a partner team on an upcoming rollout, or present a recommendation to leadership. You will balance hands-on problem-solving with clear documentation and communication throughout the day.  
  
About the team  
Today, over 60% of worldwide purchases on Amazon are for products from third-party businesses, mostly from Small- and Medium-sized businesses. Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables these businesses (our Selling Partners) to hand over the heavy lifting of warehousing, payment processing, delivery returns and customer service to Amazon, utilizing the capabilities that Amazon has built over the last 25+ years.  
  
Our team is dedicated to making Amazon's fulfillment operations as efficient and reliable as possible. We focus on identifying what can be improved across processes, tools, and systems, then work together to turn those ideas into action. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do, and we partner closely with operations, learning, and technology teams to deliver results that matter.  
  
We are building an inclusive environment where new ideas are welcomed and every team member has the opportunity to grow. If you are looking for a role where your analytical skills and initiative can make a real, measurable impact, this is the team for you.

A **Business Development Manager (BDM)** at a filmmaking institute plays a pivotal role in driving revenue, building industry partnerships, expanding student enrollment, and positioning the institute as a premier destination for media education.

Because filmmaking is a deeply portfolio- and industry-driven field, the BDM bridges the gap between **education**, **student recruitment**, and **entertainment industry networks**.

Here is a comprehensive breakdown of the key roles and responsibilities of a Business Development Manager in a filmmaking institute:

**1. Student Enrollment & Revenue Growth**

* **Lead Generation & Pipeline Management:** Identify, target, and acquire prospective students for various filmmaking courses (Degree programs, Diplomas, Short-term Bootcamps, and Masterclasses).
* **Counseling & Conversion:** Oversee or collaborate with the admissions team to convert leads into enrollments through open days, campus tours, webinar presentations, and 1-on-1 counseling.
* **Corporate & Institutional Tie-ups:** Partner with high schools, colleges, and university arts departments to conduct workshops, talent hunts, and roadshows to build early-funnel awareness.
* **Pricing & Scholarship Strategy:** Analyze market demand to propose competitive pricing models, early-bird offers, or industry-sponsored scholarship programs.

**2. Industry Partnerships & Placements**

* **Production House Tie-Ups:** Build relationships with film production houses, OTT platforms (Netflix, Amazon Prime, Hotstar, etc.), ad agencies, and post-production studios to secure internships, apprenticeships, and job placements for students.
* **Guest Lectures & Masterclasses:** Network with established directors, cinematographers, screenwriters, editors, and actors to invite them as guest faculty or masterclass mentors.
* **Equipment & Tech Sponsorships:** Collaborate with camera, lighting, editing, and audio technology brands (e.g., RED, Arri, Blackmagic, Sony, Adobe, DaVinci Resolve) for hardware/software sponsorships, student discounts, and joint workshops.

**3. Brand Outreach, Events & Festivals**

* **Film Festival Collaborations:** Partner with local, national, and international film festivals to showcase student films, host panel discussions, or secure student accreditation/tickets.
* **Campus Events & Open Days:** Plan and execute flagship events such as Annual Student Film Screenings, Film Pitching Competitions, and Industry Mixer Nights.
* **Community Building:** Build relationships with local filmmaking communities, film clubs, and independent creators to keep the institute at the center of the regional film ecosystem.

**4. Product & Course Development Support**

* **Market Research & Trend Analysis:** Keep track of emerging industry trends (e.g., AI in filmmaking, Virtual Production/Unreal Engine, OTT content trends, drone cinematography) and advise the academic head to introduce relevant new courses or workshops.
* **Executive & B2B Training:** Develop corporate training programs, custom workshops for brands, media houses, or content creators seeking upskilling in video production.

**5. Strategic Alliances & Expansion**

* **International Alliances:** Explore student exchange programs, dual-degree pathways, or credit-transfer agreements with foreign film schools and universities.
* **Franchising / Multi-Center Expansion:** If applicable, identify new locations, franchise partners, or online learning platform opportunities to expand the institute’s footprint.

jobs.title: Product Manager/Strategy 3-ProdDev
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
As a Product Manager at Oracle NetSuite, you will help shape and deliver supply chain, Mobile, and Warehouse Management solutions from discovery through release. You will work closely with engineering, design, quality assurance, support, and go-to-market teams to solve customer problems and deliver products on schedule and within budget.
  
  
You will define product strategy, requirements, and priorities using customer feedback, business needs, and product insights. A key part of the role is identifying where GenAI and intelligent automation can simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve the user experience. You will translate these opportunities into clear requirements and measurable outcomes, considering accuracy, data privacy, and user control.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include aligning teams on product decisions, reviewing designs and documentation, managing dependencies, and supporting successful releases. You will also use AI tools to improve product discovery, requirements development, documentation, and test planning, while applying sound judgment to their outputs.
  
  
This role requires independent judgment, strong communication, and the ability to manage complex priorities. You may lead cross-functional initiatives and mentor junior colleagues. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience, is required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Responsbilities:
  
  

* Collaborate with Manufacturers and Wholesale Distributors to build the next generation of supply chain solution
* Proactively define and drive the creation of new features that customers love
* Identify opportunities to use GenAI and intelligent automation to simplify workflows, improve decisions, and reduce manual effort
* Create use cases, user stories, and detailed product requirements document that clearly articulate desired product functionality
* Collaborate with Development, QA, Doc, and UI to deliver great products and tools for both the customers as well as developers
* Build a strong understanding of the market, competitive landscape, and emerging AI capabilities relevant to supply chain operations
* Manage the product backlog and prioritize product enhancements, customer and partner requests by making smart, decisive tradeoffs using data-driven analysis and sound judgment
* Partner with Marketing, Sales, Professional Services and Support to successfully rollout our products and ensure a great end-to-end customer experience
* Evaluate AI-enabled features for usefulness, accuracy, reliability, and appropriate user control

Qualifications/Skills:
  
  

* Must be a self-motivated team player
* Ability to gather complex customer requirements and translate requirements into a detail plan for execution
* Strong functional knowledge in at least two areas: Inventory, Warehouse Management, Fulfillment, Shipping, or Outbound Order Processing
* Preferably 5+ years of product management experience, with experience delivering applications through at least two product releases
* Practical experience with GenAI or AI-related projects is a plus, particularly in enterprise applications, workflow automation, or decision support
* Ability to identify meaningful AI use cases and define how their value and quality will be measured.
* B.Tech or Bachelor of Engineering required. MBA a plus

Oracle NetSuite is investing in GenAI and AI-powered capabilities to improve supply chain execution, decision-making, and productivity. In this role, you will help shape intelligent workflows, predictive insights, automated configuration, and GenAI-enabled experiences across Mobile and WMS, making everyday work simpler and more effective for customers.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Product Manager - Business Platforms & Technology

ISB is looking for a Product Manager – Business Platforms & Technology who can solve business problems end-to-end. The role will be the single product point of contact for business requirements—understanding the problem, designing the right solution, documenting requirements, working with engineering/IT teams, driving delivery, and measuring outcomes after launch. * Create clear PRDs, BRDs, user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements

jobs.title: Applied AI Product Specialist II
jobs.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Product Specialist II**
An Applied AI Product Specialist II is a mid-level individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross-functional product teams to solve customer problems that align with business needs. Being a mid-level product management role, you will have the opportunity to own products of lesser complexity that drive business value. The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist, like any of our product managers, is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. This role harnesses AI and agentic tools to compress the concept-to-cash learning loop—automating analysis, prototyping, and compliance detail-work so the team can focus on the human judgment AI cannot replace: product sense-making.
  
  
The Applied AI Product Specialist II plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of our less complex yet valuable products by balancing customer needs with business objectives. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, analytical skills, and collaborative teamwork to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. It demands some experience in the modern product management craft and a drive for continuous improvement—amplified by the fluent, responsible use of AI to learn faster and earn faster.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**

* Product Accountability

+ Responsible and accountable for the product's value and viability showcasing a measurable Return on Investments (ROI)
+ Drive strategy-aligned solutions to achieve product value objectives.
+ Formulate and achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for identified problems to solve.
+ Measure KPIs and analyze outcomes to inform future strategies.
+ Leverage AI to harvest outcome evidence early and often, lowering total cost of ownership (TCO).

* Vision and Strategy

+ Co-create, own, and evangelize the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, using AI to deepen domain knowledge and simulate future scenarios to chart pathways others have not yet seen.
+ Align product objectives with the product line and business goals.
+ Co-create in collaboration with business stakeholders, engineering, experience, and delivery.

* Market and User Engagement

+ Conduct user research and competitive analysis, using AI agents to synthesize research at speed—accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
+ Engage the team with users and stakeholders through continuous research and direct interactions.
+ Collaborate and guide the team toward solutions that address priority user and business needs.

* Collaboration and Teamwork

+ Work side-by-side with cross-functional (business, engineering, experience, and delivery) team members to achieve KPI outcomes.
+ Promote a product operating model that emphasizes outcomes over output (minimize overproduction while maximizing value).
+ Build empowered teams and product communities who exhibit collective product ownership.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Remove obstacles for the team and ensure smooth flow of continuous value achievement.
+ Promote and drive rapid, emergent, and ongoing learning and adaptation to meet objectives.
+ Drive innovation and improvement of the process to drive out waste and accelerate value achievement, using AI as a force-multiplier to offload the repetitive, speed up the sluggish, and automate the mundane.
+ Spread knowledge and best practices within the product vertical community.

* Applied AI Ways of Working

**EMPLOYER OVERVIEW**: An innovative AI-driven SaaS platform specializing in cutting-edge quality engineering solutions for desktop, web, mobile, and API applications.

  

**LOCATION**: Bengaluru (South).

  

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop, rigorously test, and continually maintain highly dynamic, responsive web applications utilizing Angular for all front-end architectures.
* Construct and maintain robust, scalable back-end services and application programming interfaces using Python, specifically leveraging Django or Flask frameworks.
* Collaborate extensively with cross-functional teams including designers, product managers, and peer developers to define, engineer, and implement innovative software solutions.
* Write impeccably clean, highly efficient, and easily maintainable code that strictly adheres to established industry best practices.
* Actively participate in comprehensive code reviews to ensure maximum code quality, security, and systemic scalability.
* Optimize all application components for maximum speed, performance, and operational scalability under varying loads.
* Proactively troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve complex systemic issues, software bugs, and performance bottlenecks across the application ecosystem.
* Maintain a continuous learning trajectory regarding the latest industry trends, emerging technologies, and software engineering best practices.

  

**MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERTISE**

* Professional Tenure: A minimum of 5 years of proven, hands-on professional experience in developing complex web applications utilizing Angular, with a strong preference for Angular version 8 or higher.
* Back-End Proficiency: A minimum of 2 years of dedicated professional experience in Python development, demonstrating distinct proficiency in building applications with Django or Flask.
* API Expertise: Deep functional understanding and demonstrated experience in the development, integration, and management of RESTful APIs.
* Front-End Mastery: Extensive, demonstrable experience working with core front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Version Control: Solid familiarity and regular professional usage of version control systems, specifically Git.
* Database Management: Strong working knowledge of relational database management systems, such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, alongside practical experience utilizing ORM frameworks.
* Methodology: Proven track record of operating effectively within Agile and Scrum development methodologies.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Practical professional experience deploying and managing applications on major cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* DevOps and Deployment: Strong familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes, alongside continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines.
* Build Tools: Excellent working knowledge of front-end build and bundling tools such as Webpack or Gulp.
* Testing Protocols: Proven experience executing unit testing and operating within test-driven development environments.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional problem-solving capabilities, meticulous attention to detail, and the demonstrated ability to function with high autonomy while also thriving in a collaborative team structure.

  

**WORK PARAMETERS AND LOGISTICS**

* **Work Mode**: Hybrid environment requiring a minimum of 2 days per week and 10 days per month working directly from the office.
* **Commute**: Employees are fully responsible for their own daily commuting arrangements.
* **Working Hours**: General work timings are flexible to promote productivity.
* **Joining Timeline**: Immediate availability is highly preferred, with a strict maximum joining period of 45 days.
* **Selection Process**: The assessment consists of 3 to 4 comprehensive discussion rounds, including a mandatory L1 technical interview, 1 to 2 subsequent technical interviews, and 1 final human resources discussion.

jobs.description:
**Role**: SDET- Mobile Automation Test Engineer

**Location:** Pune

**Experience:** 4-8 years

**Notice Period**- 0-30 Days

  

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on SDET to own quality for our mobile banking and payments apps across Android and iOS. You will work inside a cross-functional squad with developers, product owners, and designers. You will build and maintain mobile automation, drive testing across the full test lifecycle, and help us ship secure, reliable financial features at speed.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable mobile automation frameworks using WebdriverIO or Playwright with Appium and TypeScript.
* Automate functional, regression, and smoke suites for Android and iOS apps, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.
* Write API tests to validate backend services that power the mobile app, including payments, onboarding, and account flows.
* Participate in every STLC phase: requirement analysis, test planning, test design, execution, defect reporting, and test closure.
* Review user stories and acceptance criteria early in the sprint to catch gaps, edge cases, and testability issues.
* Log, track, triage, and retest defects in Jira with clear reproduction steps, severity, priority, and evidence.
* Maintain test cases, test runs, and traceability in TestRail or an equivalent test management tool.
* Run tests on real devices and cloud device farms, and analyse failures across OS versions and device models.
* Report quality metrics such as automation coverage, pass rates, flaky tests, and defect trends to the squad.
* Collaborate with developers on unit and integration test coverage, and promote a shift-left quality mindset.

  

**Must Have**

* **4+ years** of hands-on experience in test automation, with at least 2 years on mobile app automation.
* **Appium:** strong experience automating Android and iOS apps (native and/or hybrid).
* **WebdriverIO or Playwright:** hands-on experience using either as the automation framework.
* **TypeScript / JavaScript (Node.js):** strong programming skills, including async/await, OOP, and clean code practices.
* **Framework design:** experience with Page Object Model or a similar pattern, reusable components, and config-driven execution.
* **STLC:** solid understanding of the test lifecycle, test design techniques (boundary value, equivalence partitioning, decision tables), and test types (functional, regression, smoke, sanity).
* **Defect management:** proven experience writing clear bug reports, defining severity vs. priority, running triage, and owning the defect lifecycle.
* **Jira & test management:** working knowledge of Jira for stories and defects, and TestRail (or Zephyr, Xray, qTest) for test case management.
* **API testing:** experience with a code-based tool (Axios, SuperTest, or similar) and familiarity with Postman.
* **Git & CI/CD:** experience running automation in pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI.
* **Mobile testing know-how:** gestures, permissions, interruptions, network conditions, app install/upgrade, and device fragmentation.
* **Agile:** experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.
* **Communication:** clear written and verbal communication in English.

  

**Nice to Have**

* **Fintech or banking domain** experience, such as payments, wallets, KYC/onboarding, card management, or transaction flows.
* **Fintech quality awareness:** data accuracy, transaction integrity, audit trails, and regulatory compliance.
* **Cloud device farms** such as LambdaTest, BrowserStack, or Sauce Labs.
* **Test runners & reporting:** Mocha or Jest, and reporting tools like Allure.
* **Mobile performance testing:** app launch time, memory, battery, and network usage.
* **Tool integration:** pushing CI test results into TestRail via APIs.
* **Debugging tools:** Android Studio, Xcode, ADB, and device logs.
* **SQL** for backend data validation.
* **Contract testing / mocking:** Pact, WireMock, MSW, or similar.
* **AI-assisted testing tools** for test generation, self-healing locators, or failure analysis.

  

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of quality for a high-impact fintech product
* A modern automation stack and room to shape testing practices

jobs.description:
Job Description: Data Modeler Master Data Management (MDM)

**Location:** Bangalore  
**Experience:** 6-8 Years

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced **Data Modeler with strong SAP/ERP domain knowledge and functional business understanding** to join our Master Data Management (MDM) practice.

The role involves translating business and functional requirements into structured, scalable data models, primarily using data sourced from SAP and Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365). You will work closely with data architects and internal technical teams to understand source-system structures, perform data mapping and exploratory data analysis (EDA), identify data quality issues, and support ETL pipeline design.

The ideal candidate will have a background in **Business Analysis and hands-on Data Modeling**, along with practical knowledge of SAP functional modules such as FICO, MM, or SD and a strong understanding of Finance, Sales, or Revenue Growth Management (RGM) processes.

Key Responsibilities

* Collaborate with data architects to understand business requirements, functional processes, and source-system configurations.
* Translate functional requirements into logical and physical data models aligned with business and MDM requirements.
* Analyze SAP and D365 source data, including relevant tables, relationships, master data, and transactional data structures.
* Perform data mapping and exploratory data analysis (EDA) to understand source data, validate assumptions, and identify gaps.
* Identify, investigate, and resolve common ERP data quality issues, including duplicates, missing values, inconsistent master data, and data integrity issues.
* Design and maintain data models for business domains such as Finance, Sales, Materials Management, and Revenue Growth Management.
* Support ETL pipeline design and development by defining source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, data validation logic, and reconciliation requirements.
* Work with architects and data engineering teams to refine ambiguous requirements and ensure the data models accurately represent business processes.
* Document data definitions, business rules, relationships, transformation logic, and modeling decisions.
* Support data integration and master data standardization initiatives across ERP systems.

Required Skills and Experience

* 68 years of overall experience, including hands-on experience in data modeling and business analysis.
* Proven experience designing data models based on business requirements and source-system data.
* Direct exposure to SAP or similar ERP platforms, with the ability to explain specific module-related tables, data structures, relationships, and common data quality challenges.
* Strong functional knowledge in at least one of the following areas:

+ **SAP FICO:** Financial accounting, general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, and controlling.
+ **SAP MM:** Procurement, purchasing, material master, inventory management, and goods movements.
+ **SAP SD:** Sales orders, deliveries, billing, customer master, and sales transactions.
+ **RGM / Sales / Finance:** Revenue, pricing, promotions, sales operations, financial processes, or related business workflows.

* Experience translating business and functional requirements into conceptual, logical, or physical data models.
* Practical experience with data mapping, source-to-target analysis, EDA, and data quality validation.
* Exposure to ETL processes, data transformation, data integration, and reconciliation.
* Previous experience as a Senior Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, or Data Analyst with demonstrable hands-on data modeling responsibilities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Good to Have

* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) or exposure to multiple ERP systems.
* Experience across multiple SAP functional modules or business domains.
* Exposure to Azure or other cloud-based data platforms.
* Familiarity with SQL, data profiling, data engineering, and ETL tools.
* Experience in the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry.
* Exposure to Master Data Management (MDM), data governance, and data standardization initiatives.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate combines **functional business knowledge with practical data modeling expertise**. They should understand how SAP or ERP data represents real business processes and be able to convert that understanding into reliable data models and source-to-target mappings.

Candidates whose experience is limited to SAP end-user activities, reporting, or technical data extraction without functional understanding and hands-on data modeling are unlikely to be suitable.

**Primary evaluation priorities:**

1. SAP/ERP domain knowledge and functional understanding.
2. Hands-on data modeling experience.
3. Strong grounding in Finance, Sales, or RGM.
4. Data mapping, EDA, ETL, and data quality experience.
5. Ability to collaborate with architects in an internal, non-client-facing role.

**Note:** CPG experience and cloud/data engineering exposure are advantageous but not mandatory. Strong functional grounding and data modeling capability are the primary selection criteria.

**Role:**Senior Business Analyst

**Domain:** Pharma / Healthcare Market Access & Payer Coverage

  

**Experience :** 5+ years in a Business Analyst capacity

**Mandatory Skills:**Tableau + SQL • Payer Analytics (Claims + eLAAD + MMIT)

  

**ROLE OVERVIEW**  
We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst with deep, hands-on understanding of lives-oriented formulary data to anchor requirements and delivery on a data-heavy enterprise market-access platform. The ideal candidate has worked directly with syndicated formulary sources such as MMIT Searchlight, fluently navigates payer and patient-access concepts, and can translate complex commercial data into precise, build-ready specifications for engineering and AI teams.  
This is a workstream-owning role. You will lead discovery, define business rules across conflicting data sources, author rigorous documentation, and partner closely with brand, market access, field reimbursement, and data engineering teams. Hands-on payor analytics across Claims, eLAAD, and MMIT data, delivered through SQL and Tableau, is essential to connect formulary coverage signals to real-world utilisation.  
**MUST HAVE**

* **5+** years as a Business Analyst in pharma/healthcare, with direct exposure to market access or payer coverage data.
* **Tableau (mandatory)**  hands-on experience designing and building Tableau dashboards and reports for commercial / market access stakeholders.
* **SQL (mandatory)**  strong ability to write complex queries (joins, aggregations, window functions) to profile, validate, and analyse large payer and claims datasets.
* **Payor Analytics (mandatory)**  hands-on experience with Claims, eLAAD, and MMIT data, including linking coverage / formulary positions to claims-based utilisation and patient access outcomes.
* **Strong working knowledge** of formulary / lives-oriented data specifically MMIT Searchlight (or equivalent syndicated formulary data sources).
* **Understands core payer / access concepts:** coverage tiers, prior authorisation (PA), step therapy, utilisation management (UM) criteria, lives / covered lives, Rx vs. Mx benefit, and book of business (Commercial / Medicare / Medicaid / HIX).
* **Experience writing detailed** functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for data-heavy enterprise applications.
* **Comfortable reading and reconciling** multiple conflicting data sources (e.g., syndicated data vs. field-submitted intelligence) and defining business rules for conflict resolution.
* **Experience with data modelling /** schema definition (entity relationships, source-to-target mapping) able to work directly with data engineers on table structures.
* **Skilled in stakeholder management** with brand teams, market access, and field reimbursement (FRM) teams.
* **Strong documentation skills**  BRDs, process flows, data dictionaries, and UAT scripts.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* **Exposure to** additional RWD sources beyond the core payor stack (e.g., IQVIA, Symphony, or similar) and how they complement formulary / syndicated data.
* **Exposure to** Policy Reporter, FRM / market access submission tools, or similar payer policy tracking platforms.
* **Experience working on** Databricks-based or Unity Catalog-governed data platforms.
* **Prior experience defining requirements for** AI / Genie-style natural language query tools or RAG-based search.
* **Background in RBAC / permissioning** design for sensitive commercial data (pricing, rebates).
* **Exposure to agile delivery** (sprint planning, backlog grooming) in a multi-workstream program.

**SOFT SKILLS**

* **Excellent communicator**  able to translate technical constraints to business stakeholders and vice versa.
* **Strong facilitation skills** for discovery workshops and requirement walkthroughs.
* **Detail-oriented** with high data quality standards comfortable challenging ambiguous or conflicting inputs.
* **Self-directed** and comfortable owning a workstream with minimal day-to-day oversight.
* **Collaborative across cross-functional** teams (engineering, AI / ML, brand, market access, compliance).
* **Calm under pressure** when reconciling competing stakeholder priorities or tight release timelines.

**WHY THIS ROLE**  
You will own a critical workstream on a flagship market-access data platform, shaping how syndicated formulary intelligence, field-submitted data, and claims signals come together into a single trusted source. If you enjoy working at the intersection of payer-access domain depth, rigorous data definition, and modern AI-enabled delivery, this role offers the scope to make a visible, lasting impact.

**About the Team**

The Commerce Platform team at Meesho drives end-to-end growth, strategy, and operational excellence across key verticals:

* **User Growth:** Scales the full lifecycle funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention. The User Growth team also houses Meesho’s branding pods, which shape how Bharat sees, trusts and keeps coming back to Meesho.
* **Marketplace:** Focuses on strengthening the seller ecosystem and improving selection quality to create a robust and reliable marketplace experience.
* **Category:** Identifies high-potential segments, launches and scales new categories, and drives assortment expansion to meet evolving customer demand.
* **Mall:** Builds a trusted branded destination for quality-conscious users, enhancing the platform’s premium and branded shopping experience.
* **Pricing:** Ensures competitiveness and affordability, enabling the platform to deliver strong value for customers while maintaining marketplace health.
* **Content Commerce:** Powers content-led discovery through creator ecosystems and inspiration-driven shopping journeys that drive engagement, trust, and conversion.

Together, these verticals identify whitespace opportunities, launch and scale new initiatives, and continuously optimize the user lifecycle through data-backed decisions. Operating in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment, the team combines structured problem-solving with rapid execution to deliver meaningful impact.

If you’re excited about building a brand that millions across Bharat love and return to, this role offers both strategic depth and hands-on impact.

**About the Role**

As a Manager – Programs (Branding), you will anchor the branding pods within User Growth. You will own Meesho’s brand strategy end to end: understanding what holds users back and what brings them back, turning those insights into sharp brand briefs, and leading the campaigns that land them across TV, digital and influencers.

This is a hands-on role for a brand builder, not a documentation role. You will spend time with users first-hand, shape communication for India’s many consumer cohorts, and lead a team that delivers large, high-impact campaigns that move user growth and retention.

* **Team Leadership:** Lead and develop the branding pod, set priorities, raise the creative and strategic bar, and remove roadblocks to execution.

### **What you will need**

* **Education:** MBA from a top-tier institute (IIM, ISB or similar) with a subsequent move into branding, or a specialist branding background (e.g., MICA). Other strong MBA or brand profiles are welcome.
* **Experience:** 4+ years of hands-on experience in brand management or consumer marketing, preferably in FMCG or e-commerce.
* **Hands-on Branding:** Prior, direct branding experience is essential, including building brand strategy and briefs yourself.
* **First-hand Consumer Understanding:** Demonstrated experience of personally interacting with consumers, synthesizing insights, and translating them into a brand brief or campaign.
* **Campaign Ownership:** Direct ownership of significant campaigns across TV, digital and/or influencers, with at least one major career highlight and measurable impact.
* **Communication:** Excellent storytelling, negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to generate buy-in from senior stakeholders and external partners.
* **Leadership:** Team management experience and the ability to advocate for user-driven decisions while thinking critically and executing tactically.

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.

Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.

**Engineering Operations Lead**

**Location:** Pune/Bengaluru, India (hybrid) | **Team:** Engineering | **Reporting to:** CTO | **Level**: Senior Individual Contributor

------------

jobs.description:
**About Target:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.

**About Team & Role:**

Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.

Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.

As a Director of Product Management, you will set the overall strategic vision for your product portfolio and lead the team in delivering measurable business outcomes. You will establish short- and long-term product goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and manage product budgets and financials.

The Director of Product Management based in India is a strategic product leader responsible for accelerating Service Centre product capabilities and AI adoption, strengthening execution rigour, prioritising investments, enabling operational efficiency, and providing leadership across Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams globally and locally.

Further the role will be responsible for

* Driving day-to-day product excellence and velocity of Cross-functional teams
* Ensuring strong alignment between global product strategy and local execution, especially faster decision making
* Elevating product thinking, maturity, innovation, and data-driven decision-making leveraging Digital-first mindset.
* Serving as the site leader for product team functionally reporting to the US product leader

**Detailed Job Description:**

Success in this role requires balancing strategic thinking with execution excellence, fostering strong product and engineering practices, and building high-performing teams. This leader will transform servicing data into actionable enterprise insights, accelerate digital adoption, reduce friction across customer journeys, and create scalable, reusable platforms that strengthen loyalty, improve productivity, and unlock enterprise value.

You will build, coach, and mentor a strong team of Product Managers while fostering a culture of progress, transparency, accountability, and efficiency. You will elevate the team’s performance by providing insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback and by partnering with senior leaders and peers across pyramids to resolve execution-related barriers.

You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, validating hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering capacity. You will guide complex work across multiple pyramids and interrelated specialities. You will use data and analytics to assess market context, inform decisions, evaluate product health and effectiveness, understand P&L impact, and provide clear recommendations to key stakeholders.

You will possess or develop a strong understanding of servicing platforms and systems, including data flows, transaction sequences, relevant technologies, and design principles, to enable innovative and scalable solutions across Target.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of product management experience, including experience leading product teams, preferably within retail, consumer, or servicing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading product-driven business transformation.
* Experience managing product portfolios, investment priorities, budgets, financials, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology, data, analytics, and digital product development.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders across complex, cross-functional organisations.
* Expertise in establishing product vision, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, and success measures.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and lead high-performing product teams.
* Expertise in agile product-development practices, including iterative development, discovery, experimentation, and backlog management.

**Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to own the vision, strategy and execution of the roadmap for SmartSense CRE, Ecolibrium's commercial real estate product line within the broader SmartSense platform. The role will work closely with Engineering, Design, Field Operations, Sales and Delivery to turn market insight and customer feedback into products that are competitive, high-quality and aligned to Ecolibrium's business goals.

The Senior Product Manager will lead market research, define product strategy, guide development from concept to launch and track performance against clear KPIs. SmartSense is a technically layered product spanning real-time IoT telemetry, deterministic rules engines, machine learning models and, in select modules, conversational AI. This role requires strong strategic thinking, genuine technical fluency across these layers, stakeholder management and the ability to inspire and align teams around a shared product vision. Requires 7+ years of relevant experience.

**THE WORK**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement product vision, strategy and roadmap for SmartSense CRE, in alignment with Ecolibrium's business goals.
* Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis, including in AI-enabled energy and building management tooling, to identify trends, opportunities and customer needs.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design and other teams to guide product development from concept through to launch, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
* Define product requirements for AI-driven features (ML forecasting models, conversational AI modules) with the same rigour as deterministic features, including clear scoping of what the AI is and is not responsible for.
* Engage internal and external stakeholders, including customers, to gather feedback, understand requirements and ensure product success.
* Define and monitor key product performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and inform product decisions.
* Drive continuous product improvement through customer feedback, data analysis and industry best practices.
* Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with cross-functional teams to achieve product goals.
* Translate market insights and customer needs into actionable product requirements and prioritised backlogs.
* Partner with Sales and Presales to support go-to-market activities, positioning and customer-facing product narratives, ensuring AI capabilities are represented accurately and never overstated.
* Lead and motivate cross-functional teams, setting a compelling product vision that inspires others to deliver against it.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
* 7+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of leading successful product initiatives.
* Experience in IoT, building management systems or related industries is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of product development processes, market research techniques and data analysis tools.
* Working fluency with AI product concepts: able to distinguish deterministic rule-based logic from machine learning and from LLM-based conversational features, and to make sound product decisions about where each is appropriate.
* Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Ability to think strategically and translate market insights into actionable product strategies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical and AI-related concepts to diverse, including non-technical, stakeholders.
* Strong customer orientation with a passion for creating products that deliver exceptional value and user experience.

**Desirable**

* Experience as a visionary, analytical and collaborative product leader who thrives on solving complex problems.
* Exposure to energy management, industrial IoT or connected-building product categories.
* Direct experience shipping AI or ML-powered features, including forecasting models, anomaly detection or conversational/LLM-based assistants, and communicating their capabilities and limits honestly to clients.
* Familiarity with agile product development and data-driven experimentation.
* Awareness of responsible AI practices relevant to enterprise B2B products, such as per-tenant data isolation, model risk considerations and honest disclosure of AI capability and certification status.

**We Are Hiring | Product Manager, Enterprise AI Platform | Bengaluru**

**About ReN3**

ReN3 is a sovereign AI platform for the enterprise, built to unify an organization's knowledge and let teams execute AI-powered work under strict governance and access control. The platform runs in air-gapped, private-cloud, or other sovereign environments, so sensitive data never leaves the client's own infrastructure. ReN3 works with government, banking and financial services, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, and construction clients, and partners with major infrastructure and cloud providers on deployment.

**About the Role**

As a Product Manager, you will own a product area from start to finish: the customer problem, the spec, the build, the eval, the release and adoption. You will work directly with engineers, the field team and customers. You create your own path, even when there’s no roadmap to follow, and stand confidently by the choices you make.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own one or two product areas.**
  Examples: agents and workflows, knowledge ingestion and search, or admin and governance.
* **Turn customer reality into decisions.**
  Join customer calls, read RFPs and field requests, and decide what to build, what to defer and what to refuse.
* **Write specs that ship.**
  Your specs cover acceptance criteria, edge cases, permission rules, empty states and failure states. They should be clear enough for a coding agent to build from and for an engineer to review against.
* **Build things yourself.**
  Use coding agents to make prototypes, internal tools, scripts and small product fixes. Opening a PR for a copy change or a UI tweak is part of the job.
* **Define quality for AI features.**
  Build eval sets and golden prompts. Measure answer quality, latency and cost. Make ship or no-ship calls from data, not from a good demo.
* **Run releases.**
  Prioritise, cut scope, write release notes, and equip the field team to sell, deploy and support what shipped.
* **Measure adoption.**
  Know which features customers use, which they don't and why.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must-have**

* Based in Bengaluru
* **3–5 years in product management**
  , at least 2 of them on B2B SaaS, developer or platform products. Engineers and founders who moved into product are welcome.
* **Daily use of agentic coding.**
  You have shipped something real, mostly built with coding agents: a prototype, an internal tool or a side project. You can show it and explain where the agent went wrong.
* **A working understanding of LLM products:**
  retrieval (RAG), tool calling, context limits, hallucination and evals. You know why a demo that works 8 times out of 10 is not yet a product.
* **High agency**
  . Take initiative, solve problems, deliver results, adapt quickly, and own your outcomes.
* **Clear writing.**
  Short specs, crisp decisions, no filler.
* **Comfortable with enterprise requirements:**
  SSO, roles and permissions, audit logs, data residency and security questionnaires.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience using evaluation tooling such as promptfoo, Braintrust or LangSmith.
* Experience with enterprise sales cycles, RFPs or tenders.
* Products shipped into banking, government or other regulated industries.

**How to apply**

* Submit your resume (more specifications below).
* Ensure your resume includes a link to something you built mostly with coding agents (a repo, a live URL or a 3-minute Loom).
* Ensure your resume includes a short paragraph on one thing the agent got wrong and how you caught it.

● Monitor changes across browser ecosystems, IAB standards, identity frameworks, and industry regulations to assess impact on Media.net products.

● Evaluate external vendors and platforms related to consent management, identity resolution, and privacy tooling.

**Requirements:**

● 4+ years of Product Management experience in adtech, martech, programmatic advertising, or large-scale data platforms.

● Strong understanding of RTB systems, SSP/DSP ecosystem, ad serving infrastructure, and programmatic data flows.

● Experience working on products involving privacy, compliance, consent management, identity, or data governance.

● Familiarity with privacy regulations such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and emerging frameworks including DPDPA.

● Understanding of consent frameworks including IAB TCF and GPP.

● Comfortable working with APIs, event pipelines, tracking systems, and technical platform teams.

● Strong execution and cross-functional stakeholder management skills.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

**About the position:**  
  
Chevron ENGINE has an exciting opportunity for a Digital Engineer - Eastern Hemisphere deployment to join the Facilities Engineering & Projects. This role will be based in Chevron’s office in Bengaluru.

The Digital Twin Deployment Engineer role is part of the Facilities Engineering Digital Solutions organization and supports the successful deployment, adoption, and operational integration of Digital Twin capabilities across Eastern Hemisphere assets, projects, and Businesses. This role focuses on coordinating site readiness, technical onboarding, workflow alignment, user enablement, data and system integration readiness, issue resolution, user training, user communications, and post-go-live stabilization required to make Digital Twin practical, reliable, and valuable in daily engineering, operations, maintenance, projects, and turnaround workflows. * Demonstrated ability to translate technical capabilities into site-ready deployment plans, workflow requirements, user onboarding actions, readiness checklists, risk registers, and practical adoption support for technical and operational users.

**Preferred qualification**

You must be available to participate in the program in person, starting from day one and for its full duration and **you are required to work from the office 5 days a week.**

  

**Why this role is important to us**

Our Global Delivery Function helps our clients achieve better investment outcomes by serving as the foundation of our organization. We perform all operational functions required to produce the back and middle office products and services that clients have contracted with State Street to provide. Our services include custody, accounting, fund administration, transfer agency, middle office and cash processing services for asset managers, asset owners, alternative investors and insurance companies across the full range of asset classes.

  
  

**What you will be responsible for:**

As an Intern you will be part of any one of the below department State Street is catering:

  
  

**Fund Accountant**

The Fund Accountant is responsible for calculating the net asset values of funds by processing daily accounting related functions to ensure funds prices are accurate and delivered to the client in a timely fashion. The Fund Accountant is the central point of contact for all accounting support functions and analyzes the information received thereby ensuring any discrepancy is monitored and resolved professionally.

  
  

**Financial Reporting Specialist**

The Financial Reporting Accountant is responsible for preparing financial statements for annual and interim cycle. They also prepare and complete first draft of audited annual and un-audited interim financial statements from trial balance including Profit and Loss Account Balance Sheet Cash Flow Schedule of Investments notes to financial statements.

  
  

**Derivatives Specialist**

The team deals with the complex futures and options processing for the entire European exchange traded derivatives, Centre of Excellence book of business and supplementary business offshored from other State Street sites. The Derivatives Group is the central point of contact for the clearing banks and client service teams on all sites. Other services include some cash instructions and the improvement of processes for recording derivative instruments accurately and efficiently.

  
  

**Financial Accountant**

Financial Accountant performs the accounting processes that may include [but is not limited to]: accounting documents processing, journal processing, payments preparation, account reconciliation preparation and verification of the reports performing other projects as assigned etc.

  
  

**Treasury Accountant**

Treasury Accountant performs the treasury processes that may include [but is not limited to]: treasury transactions processing (money market stock market), prepare/approve payments, collateral management/margins, monitor minimum required reserve in national central bank, reconciliation bank accounts (cash positions balance sheet) reports, performing other projects as assigned etc.

  
  

**Transfer Agency Administrator**

Transfer Agency Administrator is responsible for trade processing, investor account maintenance, issue reporting and resolution. You will be responsible for processing investor transaction: review documentation to ensure anti-money laundering documentation has been received and enter subscription on ISS and save documentation on to DMS.

  
  

**Middle Office Administrator**

Middle Office Administrator is responsible for processing trade file submitted by the Fund daily on trade-date, trade-date confirmation (electronic telephonic or hard copy) based upon the trade file transmitted by the Fund and trade details provided by the Fund’s approved counter parties and monitor trade fails with prime brokers counter parties and the Fund including review of prime broker/custodian fail or mismatch of reports.

  
  

**Pricing Administrator**

Pricing Administrator’s role is to assist in the accurate and efficient pricing of a range of securities held by investment funds. The principal tasks of this role is to price exchange traded securities and validation to sources such as Bloomberg Reuters and FTID.

  
  

**Risk Analyst**

The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) division within State Street Corporation establishes and maintains appropriate risk management policies guidelines and limits and assists executive and business-level management with minimizing operational credit legal regulatory reputation and other risks to the company.

  
  

**Compliance Analyst**

Investment Compliance Analyst will be responsible for monitoring compliance results on client portfolios related to Regulatory and Investment Manager (IM) mandates. Utilizing State Street’s Investment Compliance & Reporting platform the qualified candidate will complete the research analysis and reporting to ensure portfolios are in compliance with their investment restrictions.

jobs.description:
### **Job Title**

Senior Program Manager

### **Job Description**

**Senior Program Manager – Intelligent Systems & AI**

At Philips, our purpose is to improve people's health and well-being through meaningful innovation. Across enterprise imaging, radiology, cardiology and digital pathology, our healthcare informatics solutions help clinicians and health systems turn complex data into better-informed decisions. Doing that at scale takes more than great products: it takes exceptional technology, operations and execution behind them.

That is where Intelligent Systems & AI (IS&AI), within Philips Healthcare Informatics, comes in. We connect business priorities with platforms, data, automation and AI to improve how our business sells, delivers and supports customers. From commercial and service workflows to enterprise technology transformation, we work across teams and systems to remove friction, improve outcomes and create lasting value. We are looking for someone who wants to help build that future, not simply manage a plan.

  

**The opportunity**
-------------------

You will lead high-impact, cross-functional technology programs from an ambiguous business problem to an implemented solution and measurable result. You will partner closely with business leaders, product managers, engineers, architects and technology partners. Expect to move between strategic choices and operational detail, influence technical trade-offs, unblock teams and help reshape how programs run in an AI-enabled organization. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a reporting-only PMO position.

  

**Your Role**
-------------

* Translate customer and business problems into clear goals, success measures, practical scope and decisions. Work backwards from customer experience, adoption, productivity, cost or revenue impact rather than treating delivery milestones as the finish line.

* Drive complex programs from discovery and prioritization through design, build, integration, launch, adoption and value realization. Make sequencing and capacity trade-offs, resolve blockers and take accountability when plans change.

* Work closely with engineering and architecture on systems, APIs, data flows, integrations and technical dependencies across CRM, CPQ, ERP, service platforms and other enterprise applications. Understand enough to ask the hard questions and challenge choices constructively.

* Align commercial and service business leaders, product teams, engineering, operations, vendors and system integrators around one coherent roadmap. Build accountability and make decisions without relying on formal authority.

* Establish fit-for-purpose operating mechanisms that show the real risks, dependencies, owners and decisions. Communicate trade-offs clearly to senior leaders and distinguish meaningful progress from status reporting.

* Use AI, automation and modern digital tools to reduce coordination overhead, detect issues earlier and improve decision quality. Experiment, learn and scale what works, with appropriate security, privacy and human accountability.

  

**You may be a great fit if you**
---------------------------------

* Have 7+ years of experience leading complex enterprise software, digital transformation or technical programs spanning multiple teams, systems and business stakeholders.

* Bring experience from product-led technology, cloud/SaaS or enterprise-platform businesses, or from technology and digital transformation consulting where you owned delivery through implementation and adoption - not just strategy, governance or reporting.

* Hold a master's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business or a related discipline, or an MBA. Comparable exceptional experience in technical program leadership may also be considered.

* Think from first principles: you can break down an unclear problem, test assumptions, identify the real constraint and make sensible decisions with incomplete information.

* Have a track record of personally moving difficult programs forward and can explain the decisions you made, the trade-offs you navigated and the business or customer outcomes that resulted.

* Combine strategic judgment with hands-on execution. You are as comfortable framing a direction with executives as getting into the details with engineers or removing a delivery blocker.

* Bring practical technical fluency in enterprise systems, cloud or SaaS platforms, integrations and data; you can collaborate credibly with product and engineering without needing to be the person writing production code.

* Are an effective, concise communicator who earns trust across functions and cultures, surfaces uncomfortable facts early and makes complex decisions understandable.

* Are curious and comfortable using AI tools in your own work today, with a strong appetite to experiment and continuously improve how you and your team operate.

**How we work together**  
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
